premises.text: Mobile app development is hard, multi-language, expensive, and slow for non-technical users
premises.evidence_span: mobile application development is hard. It requires knowledge of many programming languages, technologies, and frameworks

premises.text: Non-technical users can drag-and-drop components to build mobile apps as easily as PowerPoint
premises.evidence_span: a non-technical user can drag and drop components and build their own awesome mobile app

premises.text: Rich component library (maps, RSS, gallery, social/call actions) with flexible styling beats cookie-cutter identical apps
premises.evidence_span: The power of App Architect is a library of components

premises.text: Apps built are native for best look, feel, and performance
premises.evidence_span: the apps that are built are native

premises.text: Live preview app lets builders test on a real device while editing
premises.evidence_span: This allows you to test and interact with the application as you're building it live on your mobile device

premises.text: Platform starts on iOS with plans to extend to other platforms and a developer marketplace like WordPress for mobile
premises.evidence_span: we see ourselves. as WordPress for mobile

premises.text: Positioning combines template simplicity with deep customization versus pure developer tools or logo-swap templates
premises.evidence_span: We have the simplicity of templates, but you can customize the app in every single way

value.text: Non-technical users can create custom native mobile apps quickly and affordably

causal_links.evidence_span: App Architect is a solution to that problem
our app editor is very easy and flexible

notes: Market size figures treated as context not premises. Soft count 7. Singleton D1: problem framing separately revisable.
